description: Source file implementing the egl::Image class and related classes for EGL image handling in ANGLE project.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Represents an EGL image object, manages its lifecycle, format, size, and interactions with siblings.

classes.name: ImageSibling
classes.description: Base class for objects that can be linked as siblings to an EGL image, managing target and source relationships.

classes.name: ExternalImageSibling
classes.description: Derived class for external EGL image siblings, interfacing with external implementation.

classes.name: ImageState
classes.description: Holds the state information of an EGL image, including target, format, size, and source.

methods.name: GetImageIndex
methods.description: Determines the image index based on EGL target and attributes.

methods.name: DisplayFromContext
methods.description: Retrieves the display associated with a given GL context.

methods.name: Image::onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when an Image is destroyed.

methods.name: Image::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the image, setting format, size, and samples based on source.

methods.name: Image::orphanSibling
methods.description: Orphans a sibling, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: Image::getFormat
methods.description: Returns the format of the image.

methods.name: Image::isRenderable
methods.description: Checks if the image is renderable in the current context.

methods.name: Image::isTexturable
methods.description: Checks if the image can be used as a texture.

methods.name: Image::getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: Image::getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: Image::getSamples
methods.description: Returns the number of samples of the image.

methods.name: Image::setLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the image.

methods.name: Image::getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label of the image.
